subject: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access - Acme Health

Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter + trust portal access

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning - quick follow up from our security team. They asked if Redwood can provide the following so we can move forward with procurement: 

- Most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering relevant services)
- A bridge letter if the report does not include the last 3 months
- Access to your trust portal (or a one-time download link) for supporting artifacts

Can you confirm availability of these items and an estimated timeline? Also, our vendor security questionnaire is attached - would you like us to start with that or should we open your trust portal and pull docs from there?

Appreciate the quick turnaround - procurement is aiming for an approval window in the next 2 weeks.

Thanks,
John Smith
Director, IT Security
Acme Health
john.smith@acmehealth.com

Hi John - thanks for the note and for sending the questionnaire. Great to hear procurement is moving quickly. We can absolutely provide what you need. Proposed next steps: 

1) I attached our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter to this reply for your records.
2) I've looped in Rishi (Head of Security Operations) - he will provision Acme Health access to our trust portal and confirm what artifacts are available there.
3) If you'd like us to complete your vendor questionnaire directly, we can take that on - otherwise you'll have read access to the portal to download docs.

Estimated timeline: I can get the trust portal invite out today; Rishi will confirm access privileges (view-only or download) by EOD tomorrow.

Let me know whether you want us to start filling the questionnaire or if we should wait for your team to pull from the portal.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole

Marissa - taking this one.
